S1-L003. Mahendra sofa ke paas se uthe. “Aao beta, sabka intezaar tha.” Ankita ne namaste kiya. Mahendra ne muskurakar uska swagat kiya, magar unki nazar ek pal ke liye uske blue outfit aur matching stole par thehar gayi.

S1-L004. Mahendra: “Blue tum par kaafi achcha lag raha hai, Ankita.” Unhone normal family tone banaye rakhi aur turant Rey se poochha, “Aur tumhara rocket kahan hai?”

S1-L005. Ankita: “Thank you, Uncle.” Woh casually muskurayi aur Shreya ki taraf mudkar dinner ki preparations ke baare mein baat karne lagi. Mahendra ki nazar ka usne koi alag matlab nahi nikala.

S1-L006. Ritvik ne Mahendra ki woh chhoti, dobara thehri hui nazar notice kar li. Use laga ki Ankita ki tareef sirf formality se thodi zyada thi; usne kuch kaha nahi.

S1-L007. Ghar se nikalne se pehle Ritvik ne hi blue outfit suggest kiya tha, halanki final choice Ankita ki thi. Ab kisi aur ki nazar mein uski wife ke liye admiration dekhkar Ritvik ko privately ek ajeeb si pleased curiosity hui.

S1-L008. Shreya ne Samar ko signal kiya ki guests ke liye paani le aaye. Rey aur Mahi carpet par drawing dekhne lage. Bado ki conversation traffic, shaadi ki arrangements aur dinner ke time par chalti rahi; Mahendra ne apne private thoughts kisi ko nahi bataye.

S1-L009. Ankita glasses arrange karne ke liye dining-side counter ki taraf badhi. Samar bhi wahi aa raha tha. Ritvik aur Mahendra drawing room mein the; wahi ordinary family movement agle private encounter, Scene 2, ka opening point ban gaya.
